description.en: One shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2 or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具，可在 Windows 上通过 PowerShell / Git Bash / MSYS2 / WSL 执行命令；另提供底部工作台的内嵌终端，支持按 shell 激活开关与默认 shell 回落链。
